quality.review_scope: Independent R3 scientific audit passed for complete six-page main and selected SI pages 1–7, 13–16 and 25–27 only. Remaining 42 SI pages remain unreviewed. Cited full references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete six-page main and explicitly selected SI pages 1–7, 13–16 and 25–27. Detailed electrochemical parameter tables and SI sections outside that page set remain unenriched; cited full sources unreviewed.

Pristine oleylamine-capped InAs, ligand-exchanged InAs, supported electrodes and post-electrolysis reconstruction are distinct specimen stages. The 2.2 nm TEM mean is assigned only to pristine QDs; no numeric size is remeasured after exchange.
The source gives flask volume, atmospheres and heating times but not vacuum pressure, injection rate, ramp, actual room temperature, cooling time or stirring rate.

Synthesis washing solvent volumes and mixing ratios, final dispersion volume and isolated yield are not given. Methanol purification comparison does not overwrite the explicitly reported first mixed-solvent wash and two later ethanol washes.
Reducing-agent and wash comparisons retain their stated variable; their complete specimen-specific schedule and quantitative phase fractions are unresolved.

Pristine and ligand-exchanged electrode recipes retain stated support dimensions and Nafion ratios. Drop-cast ink volumes and complete electrochemical tables are outside or unresolved within this declared extraction scope.
Reference ICSD structures and electrochemical active-phase interpretation are not measured particle atomic coordinates. No geometric molecular, surface or unit-cell model is asserted.
Independent source comparison passed within the declared main and selected-SI scope; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
